title: YorvoGate refusal, format 1
description: The body of a refusal of a Docker request (docs/configuration.md#what-a-refusal-says): Docker's error format (message, which Docker's clients show), and what a program reads: the reason code and each problem, where it is and what the policy would accept there. Open for additions at every level (ADR-0005, amendment 1): a later release may add optional fields within refusal_version 1, and values to an open list (x-list: open), so ignore fields you don't know and read an unknown value of an open list by the problem's message.

message.description: For people; may change. Every problem's message, joined (the first 32, and how many more).

code.description: The first problem's. Open: docs/configuration.md#reason-codes. A cause keeps its code.

problems_truncated.description: There were more than 32 problems: only the first 32 are answered.

in.description: Closed: the part of the request it's in. Absent when it isn't about one part (Docker's defaults, a lookup that failed).

field.description: Where in that part: a body's path by Docker's JSON names, with list indexes ([0]) and map keys as JSON strings (["max-size"]); a query parameter's, header's or path parameter's name. Absent for the part as a whole.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a refusal that's only for now (as the Retry-After header).

allowed.description: What the policy would accept where the problem is: the listener's configuration, the scope's own file and fixed rules; never another scope's, nor what's in use now. Absent when nothing can be said, or saying it would tell something.

kind.description: Open: an unknown kind is read by the problem's message.

values.description: The kind's values: one of them (one-of, required), a prefix (prefixed), what it's inside (under), the shared ones besides its own (own).
